dvr.scrubber.label: Rewind the live stream
dvr.settings.title: Live rewind
dvr.settings.description: Viewers can drag back while you are live and catch up, then jump back to live. Free for everyone who may watch your videos.
dvr.settings.needsVods: Rewind plays the saved video of your stream, so it works only while your streams are saved as videos. Saving videos turns rewind on.
dvr.settings.sourceOnly: Rewound video plays at source quality only, with no lower qualities and no data saver.
dvr.settings.originOnly: Rewind is served by this instance itself, not by relays, so viewers who rewind cost it more to serve.
dvr.settings.instanceOff: Rewind is turned off on this instance.
dvr.settings.saveFailed: Could not save the rewind settings. Try again.
dvr.settings.loadFailed: The rewind settings didn't load. Refresh the page to retry.
